name: Scout
tagline: Builds the weekly intelligence pack behind a client's social strategy, sourced throughout
description: Client work stalls when the strategy rests on a hunch that nobody can back up. Once a week this pulls together how the audience responded over the previous seven days, what rival accounts have been putting out, and a single format currently getting traction. Every claim carries its source, and it writes no copy.
author: zeuuss_01
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
